name: Message
summary: A short bar that tells the reader what just happened. Element Plus's message is a function that paints the bar and takes it away again; here the bar is a container, and the host decides whether it is on the page.
summaryZh: 一条短消息,告诉读者刚刚发生了什么。Element Plus 的消息是一个函数,画好条再自己收走;这里那条消息就是一个容器,在不在页面上由使用方决定。

variants.name: Info
variants.note: The default state, and the base class on its own.

variants.name: Error
variants.note: Element Plus calls this type error; the theme calls the same colour danger, so the class paints the danger role.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: A caption-sized bar, for a message that sits under a heading.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default bar needs no modifier class.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: A title-sized bar, for a message that has to be read from across the room.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The close button is a real button, so the browser owns its focus and the ring is drawn around it.

states.name: Plain
states.note: The bar sits on the page instead of floating over it: no fill behind it and no shadow of its own.

states.name: Grouped
states.note: The bar is one of several that belong together. A group is drawn as a strip of the page rather than as a set of cards floating over it.

parts.name: Status mark
parts.note: The disc in front of the text. The variant fills it with the state colour and draws the state's mark on it.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: The message itself. It keeps the mood's regular text colour — the variant never recolours the sentence.

parts.name: Close
parts.note: The button that dismisses the bar. Its mark is drawn from two borders, not written as a character.

props.name: variant
props.descriptionZh: 这条消息表示哪一种状态。

props.name: size
props.description: The height of the bar and the size of its type.

props.name: closable
props.description: Whether the bar carries a close button.
props.descriptionZh: 消息条上是否带关闭按钮。

props.name: show-close
props.description: Whether the bar carries a close button. This is Element Plus's name for `closable`; either one of them asks for the button.
props.descriptionZh: 消息条上是否带关闭按钮。这是 Element Plus 对 `closable` 的叫法,两个都能提出这个要求。

props.name: plain
props.description: Lays the bar on the page rather than over it: the fill behind it and the shadow under it are gone.
props.descriptionZh: 消息条平铺在页面上而不是浮在上面:底色和阴影都去掉。

props.name: grouping
props.description: Says that the bar is one of a group of messages of the same kind. A grouped bar is drawn as a strip of the page, so a stack of them reads as one list.
props.descriptionZh: 表示这条消息属于一组同类消息。成组的消息条画成页面上的一个条带,叠起来读起来就是一份列表。

a11y.notes: The bar is a plain container, so it carries no role of its own. A message that arrives without the reader asking for it needs a live region: give it role="status", or role="alert" when the news is urgent. The status disc is decorative — the sentence in it already says what happened — so hide it with aria-hidden. The close button is a real button, so it is in the tab order and can be pressed with the keyboard.
a11y.notesZh: 消息条本身只是一个容器,不带角色。读者没操作它就冒出来的消息需要一个 live region:给它 role="status";消息紧急时用 role="alert"。状态标记是装饰 —— 里面的那句话已经说了发生了什么 —— 用 aria-hidden 把它藏掉。关闭按钮是真的按钮,所以它在 Tab 顺序里,键盘也能按。

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Four states. The disc carries the state colour and the state's mark, and the sentence keeps the mood's regular text colour — a message never changes the reading colour of the page it lands on.
examples.descriptionZh: 四种状态。圆盘承载状态色和状态记号,句子还是 mood 常规的文字色 —— 一条消息不该改变它落上去的那一页的阅读颜色。
examples.markup:
The nightly reconciliation finished with no differences.
Six replicas were moved to build 214.
Storage is at 68% of the plan limit.
The last sync failed 12 minutes ago.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three bars. The middle one is the base class on its own, because the base class is already the medium bar.
examples.descriptionZh: 三条消息。中间那个只写基础类,因为基础类本来就是中号消息。
examples.markup:
A caption-sized message.
The default message.
A title-sized message.

examples.title: Announced
examples.description: A message that arrives on its own needs a live region, so it is announced instead of waiting to be found. The close button is a real button.
examples.descriptionZh: 自己冒出来的消息需要 live region,这样它会被播报,而不是等着被看见。关闭按钮是真的按钮。
examples.markup: The certificate was renewed.

notes: The status mark is a disc with the state's mark drawn on it, and the mark is drawn from borders rather than written as a character: a character would have to be typed into every markup and would then be read out as a word. The disc's fill and the mark's ink are the theme's own on-colour pair, so the mark is as legible as the sentence beside it.
notesZh: 状态标记是一个圆盘,状态记号画在它上面,而记号是用边框画的,不是写出来的字符 —— 字符得打进每一份标记里,而且还会被读成一个词。圆盘的底色和记号的墨色用的是主题自己的前景色搭配,所以记号和旁边那句话一样清楚。
